qualifiers.condition: the default maximum record size of a stream stays at 1 MiB; to use large records, update the stream's maximum record size limit

evidence.quote: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams now supports record sizes up to 10MiB, a tenfold increase from the previous 1MiB limit.

evidence.heading: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams now supports 10x larger record sizes

evidence.quote: The default maximum record size for existing, and newly created streams is set to 1 MiB.
To start using large records in your stream, update your stream's maximum record size limit.
